headline: Suvidhaa Infoserve approves rights issue of ₹120 cr
sum: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited's board approved a rights issue of up to ₹120 crore, with formal announcement made via NSE filing on 30 June 2026.
detail: The board of directors approved the rights issue at a meeting held on or around 30 June 2026. The maximum issue size is capped at ₹1,200 lakhs (₹120 crore). The company filed the outcome notice with the National Stock Exchange (NSE). No details on issue price, ratio, or timeline were disclosed in the primary filing. Shareholder approval and SEBI approval for the prospectus will be the critical next gates.
